title: Separate a notification from the records behind it
communicates: A notification prompts checking; ready exit records remain independently collectible.

source.title: signal(7), queueing of standard signals
source.locator: Technical constraint for an authored visual pattern

observation: Repeated pending standard signals coalesce rather than forming a counted queue.
interpretation: Use a bell for a notification and folded sheets for exit records. Show records being collected separately. A running process retains its process shape; its exit record is a different object, introduced explicitly.
avoid: Do not equate one notification with one record.
Do not depict an exited child as executing code.
Changing an established symbol’s meaning to fit this pattern.
Choosing this pattern merely because a source paragraph can be animated.
Reusing the same circle as both running worker and exit record.
Treating a text ledger as the primary high-level visualization.

review.implementation: Current reference: connected-intuition SVG vocabulary. Original HTML/CSS renderer retained for historical compatibility.

implementation_status: The renderer field supports the earlier detailed experiment only. Its prose-card demo is retired from the recommended gallery.
